name: Divine Guidance
description: You make a formal petition to a divine power, seeking guidance on a matter of importance. Roll a d100. 1-50: No answer. 51-75: Vague guidance in the form of a cryptic vision, feeling, or omen. 76-90: Clear guidance in the form of a direct and understandable answer or direction. 91-100: Divine intervention in the form of direct action, a miracle, or an unmistakable sign that alters the situation in your favor. This spell can only be cast once per day.
charge: 1-50: Vague guidance. 51-85: Clear guidance. 86-100: Divine intervention.
